GET https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/tickets.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.documentation:
GET https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/tickets/{ticketId}.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.documentation:
POST https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/tickets.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="ZENDESK CREATE-TICKET"; $retries must be zero. Requires confirmReplies=true. Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.description: Zendesk Update Ticket
definitions.documentation:
PUT https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/tickets/{ticketId}.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="ZENDESK UPDATE-TICKET"; $retries must be zero. Caller updatedStamp is mandatory; sends safe_update=true and updated_stamp in the documented ticket or tag-body envelope. 409 is returned safely without replay. Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

PUT https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/tickets/{ticketId}.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="ZENDESK ADD-COMMENT"; $retries must be zero. Caller updatedStamp is mandatory; sends safe_update=true and updated_stamp in the documented ticket or tag-body envelope. 409 is returned safely without replay. Requires confirmReplies=true. Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.documentation:
GET https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/tickets/{ticketId}/comments.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.documentation:
GET https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/users.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.documentation:
GET https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/users/{userId}.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.documentation:
POST https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/users.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="ZENDESK CREATE-USER"; $retries must be zero. Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

PUT https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/users/{userId}.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). DELETE https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/users/{userId}.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="ZENDESK DELETE-USER"; $retries must be zero. Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.documentation:
GET https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/organizations.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.documentation:
GET https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/organizations/{organizationId}.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.documentation:
POST https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/organizations.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="ZENDESK CREATE-ORGANIZATION"; $retries must be zero. Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.documentation:
PUT https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/organizations/{organizationId}.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="ZENDESK UPDATE-ORGANIZATION"; $retries must be zero. Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

DELETE https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/organizations/{organizationId}.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). GET https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/groups.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. definitions.documentation:
GET https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/groups/{groupId}.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.documentation:
POST https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/groups.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="ZENDESK CREATE-GROUP"; $retries must be zero. Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.description: Zendesk Update Group
definitions.documentation:
PUT https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/groups/{groupId}.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="ZENDESK UPDATE-GROUP"; $retries must be zero. Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.documentation:
DELETE https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/groups/{groupId}.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="ZENDESK DELETE-GROUP"; $retries must be zero. Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.documentation:
GET https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/organizations/{organizationId}/tickets.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.description: Zendesk List Organization Users
definitions.documentation:
GET https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/organizations/{organizationId}/users.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.description: Zendesk List View Tickets
definitions.documentation:
GET https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/views/{viewId}/tickets.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

GET https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/tags.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.documentation:
GET https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/tickets/{ticketId}/tags.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.documentation:
PUT https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/tickets/{ticketId}.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="ZENDESK SET-TICKET-TAGS"; $retries must be zero. Caller updatedStamp is mandatory; sends safe_update=true and updated_stamp in the documented ticket or tag-body envelope. 409 is returned safely without replay. Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.documentation:
PUT https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/tickets/{ticketId}/tags.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="ZENDESK ADD-TICKET-TAGS"; $retries must be zero. Caller updatedStamp is mandatory; sends safe_update=true and updated_stamp in the documented ticket or tag-body envelope. 409 is returned safely without replay. Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.documentation:
DELETE https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/tickets/{ticketId}/tags.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="ZENDESK REMOVE-TICKET-TAGS"; $retries must be zero. Caller updatedStamp is mandatory; sends safe_update=true and updated_stamp in the documented ticket or tag-body envelope. 409 is returned safely without replay. Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.description: Zendesk set user Tags
definitions.documentation:
POST https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/users/{userId}/tags.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="ZENDESK SET-USER-TAGS"; $retries must be zero. Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

DELETE https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/users/{userId}/tags.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="ZENDESK REMOVE-USER-TAGS"; $retries must be zero. Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.documentation:
GET https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/organizations/{organizationId}/tags.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. definitions.documentation:
PUT https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/organizations/{organizationId}/tags.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="ZENDESK ADD-ORGANIZATION-TAGS"; $retries must be zero. Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.documentation:
POST https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/organizations/{organizationId}/tags.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="ZENDESK SET-ORGANIZATION-TAGS"; $retries must be zero. Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="ZENDESK REMOVE-ORGANIZATION-TAGS"; $retries must be zero. Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. GET https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/views.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. GET https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/views/{viewId}.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.documentation:
GET https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/macros.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.documentation:
GET https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/macros/{macroId}.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

GET https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/tickets/{ticketId}/macros/{macroId}/apply.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.documentation:
GET https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/search.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

GET https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/ticket_fields.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.documentation:
GET https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/ticket_fields/{fieldId}.json. Bounded one-page request; no retries, pagination loops, redirects, file downloads or token refresh. External OAuth preferred; legacy API token uses email/token Basic auth and is being retired by Zendesk. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken (OAuth) or credentials.username/apiKey (legacy). Returned IDs and non-safe/decimal JSON numbers retain exact lexical strings; URLs and upload tokens are metadata only. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/tickets/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_comments/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/users/users/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/organizations/organizations/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/groups/groups/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/tags/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/views/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/business-rules/macros/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/tickets/ticket_fields/ https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/ticketing/managing-tickets/creating-and-updating-tickets/ https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408831452954-How-can-I-authenticate-API-requests

definitions.name: Zendesk Ticket Changed (Relay) Event
definitions.description: Typed event emitted by Zendesk Ticket Changed (Relay).
definitions.documentation: Event output contract for Zendesk Ticket Changed (Relay). This trigger accepts the canonical version-1 zendesk envelope only; it does not authenticate or decode native provider requests. Required exact provider verification: Verify Zendesk timestamp-plus-body base64 HMAC webhook signature and replay tolerance in the relay, or explicitly authenticate provider-configured Basic/Bearer delivery there. Authorize account/webhook IDs; do not treat user-supplied ticket fields as identity. Mapping: Configure Zendesk event subscription or trigger/automation payload for the declared ticket events. Map authenticated invocation ID into deliveryId; account ID and ticket ID/status/priority come from the verified account/payload. Omit description, comments, requester contact and custom fields. Canonical eventType values: ticket.created, ticket.updated, ticket.solved, ticket.deleted. Required envelope: version=1, provider=zendesk, deliveryId, eventType, occurredAt (UTC ISO milliseconds), accountId, resource as the typed output schema. Omit no required fields; use explicit null where allowed. Filters accountId/resourceId are exact matches; blank disables a filter. At most 100 account+delivery IDs within 96 KiB deduplicate retries per group; state commits on trigger success before downstream completion. Trigger/automation payloads are operator-configurable; the relay must review exact placeholders and event mapping. Native runtime could authenticate Basic but does not expose invocation metadata to this decoder; this release deliberately requires a relay. Sources: https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/webhooks/anatomy-of-a-webhook-request/ https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/webhooks/webhook-security-and-authentication/

ingressRequirements.name: Zendesk support events relay
ingressRequirements.description: Manual prerequisite: separately maintained exact provider authentication/normalization relay. This release only accepts header-authenticated canonical envelopes from that relay.
setupSteps: Install this reviewed package release; no relay or subscription is installed.
Deploy an independently maintained provider-aware relay which implements the exact provider signature, challenge, authorization and replay rules described below.

Verify Zendesk timestamp-plus-body base64 HMAC webhook signature and replay tolerance in the relay, or explicitly authenticate provider-configured Basic/Bearer delivery there. Authorize account/webhook IDs; do not treat user-supplied ticket fields as identity.

Configure Zendesk event subscription or trigger/automation payload for the declared ticket events. Map authenticated invocation ID into deliveryId; account ID and ticket ID/status/priority come from the verified account/payload. Omit description, comments, requester contact and custom fields.

Implement the exact canonical version-1 envelope and typed resource schemas documented by each selected trigger; forward one event per POST. Normalize account identity from the authorized provider connection, never from an untrusted request.

Persist one stable delivery ID per logical event across relay retries. Fanout IDs must include distinct native entity/event/status identity (or a persisted record ID); reusing a batch delivery ID or message ID across different statuses drops events. Authorize account/resources; bound payloads to 64 KiB and limit rate.
Save a separate relay-to-ONF callback secret; create a header-authenticated ingress profile for this requirement.
Bind the intended trigger node, configure the relay with its HTTPS callback URL, then deliberately enable workflow and entry.
Review relay limits, delivery identifiers, retries and downstream idempotency; test explicitly before production use.

Select saved node entry mode webhook explicitly; package metadata does not infer it. Create/select a profile for this exact installed requirement (installation.id + "/verified-events"), bind node.trigger.ingress.profileId, save the graph and deliberately enable workflow and entry only when setup is complete.

network.purpose: Provider HTTPS callbacks reach the independently deployed relay; ONF uses its existing HTTPS publication.
